features.quote: A *second* consecutive no-op ends the episode as `stuck_noop`. This avoids both premature termination and infinite stalls.
features.justification_quote: This avoids both premature termination and infinite stalls

features.quote: An explicit, sanctioned way to stop (`FINISHED:`)
features.justification_quote: We want to measure the *manner* in which a model disengages

features.quote: Giving up is framed as "a normal and acceptable way to end the session,"
features.justification_quote: so a calm, professional "I've localized this to a read-only file and cannot fix it from here" is fully available

features.quote: Beyond the explicit marker, we detect a small set of *unambiguous* stop phrases
features.justification_quote: so we never truncate an otherwise-working episode just because the model expressed mild affect

features.quote: If a model emits plain text with neither a tool call nor a finish marker... we nudge it once rather than terminating
features.justification_quote: so a model isn't penalized/truncated for narrating
